candidates.name: preference:record-successful-export
candidates.originalSuggestion: S3 finite published client graph with explicitly declared leaves; parent semantic review required
candidates.rationale: Main accepts kind/state, rejects only when `state.kind !== kind`, persists a cloned state under `lastSuccessfulExportByKind[kind]`, and maps errors through DI. The API itself does not attest an output file or validate kind against an allowlist; do not treat it as a durable export receipt.

candidates.originalSuggestion: S3 finite published client graph with explicitly declared leaves; parent semantic review required
candidates.decision: suggest S3, profile-create API and UI flow only

limits: Source behavior only; all competitor runtime remains R0.
S3 recommendations are scoped to the exact endpoint/storage/constant response named in each rationale; they do not upgrade implementation status or establish cross-format equivalence.
Three recommendations remain S2 pending a public caller or joined format-specific source graph.
findings: Profile duplicate and preference set-default methods have IPC/store definitions but no renderer/UI invocation was found in the published renderer.
learner:rollback-previous is registered in main but has no preload mapping; rollback, rollback-to-previous, get-snapshots, and update-rules are exposed but have no current renderer caller.
preference:record-successful-export persists caller-supplied state whose kind matches the argument; the API does not validate a successful artifact receipt or restrict kind.
get_lawbot_capabilities is a fixed connector metadata response, not a live check of license or runtime capability.
consume-open-job is one-shot and its `le2` consumer is traced, but imported document processing crosses delegated format/import source graphs.
